title: Riot Squad Punx Blackcurrant & Watermelon Nic salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: New from Riot Squad’s PunkX line of hybrid nicotine eliquids comes this delicious combination of two boldy contrasting fruit flavours. Tart, tangy blackcurrants weave perfectly with the delicate sweetness of fresh, ripe watermelon. Riot Squad’s Punx Nicotine Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, an innovative blend of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine and its 50/50 PG and VG ratio provides the perfect balance of flavour, throat hit and nicotine relief and makes this eliquid ideal for use in classic e-cigarette vape starter kits and pod vape kit devices.
